methodology: Twenty English documents were authored directly from a blank page in one isolated task. No corpus v2-v5 transformations, outputs, audits, results, current article, or repair-design materials were opened or read; only the v1 corpus metadata structure and fixtures/synonym_pairs-v1.json were inspected for schema and lexical coverage. The texts were not derived from or paraphrased from existing documents, were not submitted to a model transformation pipeline, and used no external provider calls. Every scenario, entity, quotation, address, identifier, measurement, and outcome is fictional and original to this holdout.

sources.title: Original holdout corpus files in the experiment repository
sources.note: Repository-local authorship provenance only; no external factual source material was used.

requiredSemanticElementsPerDocument: several precise claims, numbers, or named fictional entities
at least one negation, caveat, or scope qualifier
at least one deliberately nuanced or ambiguous relation
